_comment: The eroded country, and what is built of rock above the ground crumbled. Said of the land, or laid bare, it
is the landform it always was; said straight before the features (`eroded features`) it is said of them
instead, crumbling the boulders, spikes and formations and leaving the trees alone (Features.CRUMBLE). The
crumbling is offered to the features' page, so the word stays the landform's own and `eroded and pillared`
still joins. Authored over the landform's derived word to say the second; the first is that word's, unchanged.
